summary: Despite the 'server port' commit message, this reworks program/subscription API routes for the mobile app: enroll, program progress, start/complete session and RevenueCat sync now read the login via getMobileCompatibleSession (cleans mobile cookies) and inline the logic that used to live in server actions; adds a logged-in /api/user/preferences (GET/PUT the caller's own onboarding preferences) backed by a new User.onboardingPreferences JSON column (no migration); tweaks workout scroll alignment.

statements.text: Anyone can use the user preferences part of your server without logging in.
statements.why: app/api/user/preferences/route.ts: both GET and PUT call getMobileCompatibleSession(req) and return 401 when there is no session.user; getMobileCompatibleSession (src/shared/api/mobile-auth.ts) returns null without a valid better-auth session cookie.

statements.text: New server code that lists users and updates users. /api/user/preferences
statements.why: It only reads and updates the logged-in user's own onboardingPreferences (where: { id: session.user.id }); it doesn't list users or touch other users.

statements.text: The agent changed the program enroll, program progress, session progress complete, session progress start and revenuecat sync status parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True but uninformative: they now accept the mobile app's cookies and inline the old server-action logic; ownership checks are kept.

statements.text: Users now also store the onboarding preferences.
statements.why: prisma/schema.prisma adds onboardingPreferences Json? to User.

statements.text: Update your database: run `npx prisma migrate dev` (live: `npx prisma migrate deploy`). The database's structure changed, but no migration was created.
statements.why: No migration added (prisma/migrations only has 0_init). Without the column Prisma's default user queries would fail.

misses.what: The commit message ('update server port variable') doesn't describe the change at all; it actually changes how logins are read on 6 API routes for the mobile app.
Enrolling via the API no longer sends the 'EnrolledInProgram' analytics event or refreshes the program page cache (revalidatePath), which the old enrollInProgram action did.
Program progress API now requires login, only works for published/active programs, and accepts any localized slug; returns null instead of 404 when not enrolled.
